conclusion: Implicit-unsteady SECOND_ORDER has documented BDF2 volume-fraction accumulation in STAR-CCM+2602. A separate Segregated VOF solver and substeps=1 do not establish first-order temporal integration. There is no current evidence to replace the BDF2 mixture-mass diagnostic with backward Euler or relax the0.01percent gate.

primary_evidence.title: Interface Sharpening Using Temporal Subcycling
primary_evidence.finding: The page presents the first-order single-step form and a separate second-order VOF form. Equation2584 has BDF2 coefficients3/2,-2,1/2 for alpha. For second-order substeps, only convection is updated at sub-iterations; other terms retain global-time evaluation. Reading the first-order single-step equation alone is insufficient to infer that all one-substep runs are first-order.

primary_evidence.title: Segregated VOF Solver Reference
primary_evidence.finding: Substeps=1 is the single-step strategy. The solver reference explicitly distinguishes first-order and second-order temporal multistepping; second-order sub-iterations update convection only.

primary_evidence.title: Volume of Fluid Method
primary_evidence.finding: Mixture density is sum(rho_i*alpha_i); phase volume-fraction transport and total mixture continuity are documented. With constant phase densities and fixed volumes, the BDF2 derivative of integrated mixture density is the corresponding weighted BDF2 derivative of phase volumes. Additional configured phase/mass sources must be included if present.

primary_evidence.title: VOF Wave Forcing and Wave Damping
primary_evidence.finding: Forcing uses momentum sources only, explicitly no phase or turbulence sources. Damping introduces vertical resistance to vertical motion. Wave forcing/damping alone is not a missing mass-source term.

primary_evidence.title: Mass Flow
primary_evidence.finding: Boundary mass flow is sum(face density*face velocity dot face area), outward positive. Smooth Values uses interpolated nodal rather than cell values. Actual report smoothing, idealization, representation and native field function require inspection before treating the report as an exact discrete equation residual.

primary_evidence.title: Volume Of Fluid Multiphase Model Reference
primary_evidence.finding: Convection/HRIC order and Face Density Reconstruction are spatial settings, distinct from temporal order. First-order internal-face density reconstruction is the documented default and is less consistent between transport equations than second-order. That is a setting to inspect, not evidence by itself that the global conservation diagnostic is invalid.
